title: Chapter 3: Scum, Bunnies, and Master 2
content: “I’ve wanted to say it once. So, what do you want me to do?”
“Hehe, um, I want you to praise me, Kazu-kun. I want you to say you need me.”
Setsuna asked shyly, and I was a little taken aback.
Considering how hard Setsuna usually works, that seemed like too small a reward.
“Eh, is that really enough? I always praise you, don’t I?”
“It’s fine. Being needed by you is the best reward for me.”
I asked again just to be sure, but her answer didn’t change.
I thought she could ask for more selfish things, but if that’s what she wants, I shouldn’t press it.
Just as I wish not to work, everyone’s happiness is different. You can’t force your standards on others.
“Got it. So you want me to say it just like this?”
“Yeah♪ I’m ready to record, so please say it with feeling.”
Feeling a strange chill run down my spine, I looked away from Setsuna and down at the memo to read aloud.

“Um… ‘Good morning, Setsuna. Thanks for always working hard. Thank you for always doing your best for me. After all, there’s no one but you for me. I can’t imagine being apart from you. From now on, I’ll only think about you. You’re the only one I have. I don’t care about other girls. As long as I have you, that’s enough. Please support me for life. And spend your life with me…’”
“Wait a minute.”
As I read as instructed, a sudden voice interrupted.
“Hm? What’s up, Arisa?”
“Setsuna is asking Kazu-kun for a favor right now! You can’t just barge in!”
“Sorry, but why are you ignoring me, Setsuna? I’m with you two all the time, and I intend to be from now on too.”
Setsuna puffed her cheeks, and Arisa gave her a sideways glare.
The atmosphere wasn’t bad, but it was clear both were dissatisfied.
(Setsuna aside, Arisa is surprisingly lonely.)
From Arisa’s point of view, she probably felt left out and couldn’t accept it.
Others might not know, but this is one side of my childhood friends.
“Of course, I think Arisa is an important best friend too.”
“Then…!”
“But sometimes I want to have Kazu-kun all to myself. Just thinking about Kazu-kun looking only at me makes my heart warm and makes me happy.”
“…That’s…”
“Don’t you feel the same, Arisa? Kazu-kun made this opportunity, so I think it’s okay to be honest at times like this.”
Setsuna’s face was very kind as she gently lectured Arisa.
Apparently convinced, Arisa blushed and nodded softly, smiling a little.
It was a scene that truly showed the bond of best friends. You could even use it in a drama if you took a screenshot.
(The problem is that they’re dressed as bunny girls and having this conversation right in front of me!)
Hearing this right before me, I didn’t know what to do.
Just then, I noticed a figure approaching. There were only four people in the house, and two were talking, so I immediately guessed who it was.
“Ichinose.”
“You’re popular, Kuzuhara-sama.”
Her voice was flat. She wasn’t teasing or sarcastic, but even so, being pointed out like that was a little embarrassing, even if I’m handsome.
“Sorry, this got weird.”
“No, don’t worry. I saw something rare. But if I report this to the heiress, she might faint. She might foam at the mouth.”
“That wouldn’t be good for her health. I’d be in trouble if she didn’t pay me, so it’s better if she keeps quiet.”
“Understood.”
Ichinose nodded slightly, but her expression remained unchanged.
I couldn’t read her thoughts, but I hoped she’d keep her mouth shut.
While thinking that, Ichinose asked me something.
“This may be presumptuous, but may I ask you something, Kuzuhara-sama?”
“Hm? Sure, what is it?”
I nodded without much thought, since there was no reason to refuse, but…
“Between Takanashi-sama and Tsukishiro-sama, which do you intend to choose?”
Ichinose asked in a small voice, barely audible to the two childhood friends but clearly reaching me.
A brief silence enveloped us.
“You don’t have to answer if you don’t want to. I was just curious.”
“…Did Ijuuin order you to ask that?”
I asked back after a short pause.
It’s usually rude to answer a question with a question, but this time it was necessary.
Ichinose’s question was quite intrusive.
Love-related questions are hard to ask even to close people. Or maybe it’s easier because we’re not that close yet?
I’m not well-versed in these matters, so it’s just a guess.
First, I needed to know why Ichinose asked this.
“No, it’s my personal interest. During the last break, it seemed you two had quite a bit of trust in Kuzuhara-sama.”
“Is that how it looked to you, Ichinose?”
“Women don’t let someone they don’t like touch their hair.”
“I see.”
That made sense.
Girls take great care of their hair and their styling.
I’d heard even close friends rarely let others touch it, so combined with the classroom conversation, it was enough to judge.
“Well, to be honest, even childhood friends rarely give money. I have no intention of serving the heiress… unless I meet my true master.”
Ichinose’s eyes, staring at me intently, had a look of expectation.
I didn’t know what it was—simple curiosity or something else.
But from what had been said, it was definitely a question out of personal interest.
So I didn’t have to answer, and it was fine to refuse.
She said I didn’t have to answer if I didn’t want to.
A simple “no comment” would end this, and we could return to the cosplay shoot as if nothing happened.
That would be the right choice. I knew that much.
But—
“Ichinose wants to know which one I like more, Setsuna or Arisa.”
I deliberately continued the conversation.
Because of height differences, I looked down at Ichinose, meeting her eyes directly.
Her eyes wavered at my words, but only for a moment.
Then she nodded slightly and answered clearly in a small voice, “Yes.”
“Alright. Then I’ll answer. I—”
Now that we had confirmed our intentions, there was no reason to hesitate.
I met Ichinose’s gaze and gave her the answer she wanted.
“I have no intention of choosing either. I do like them, but if you ask who I’d choose, I’d pick money without hesitation. What I love most is money.”
“So I have no intention of choosing either of the two who earn money I love. I’d never let go of girls who say they’ll support me for life.”
“Ku-Kuzuhara-sama? Do you realize what you’re saying!? That’s basically saying you’re going to two-time them!?”
Ichinose’s face was terrifying after hearing my answer.
Her expressionless mask fell away, and she was clearly shaken.
“Don’t say such a bad thing, Ichinose. We’re not dating and don’t plan to, so it’s not two-timing. Besides, idols can’t have relationships. I know that much.”
“That’s even worse! You understand their feelings but only want to take their money!?”

“? What’s wrong with that? They’ll support me for life, and I’ll get most of the money they earn, right? Setsuna and the others say they’re happy to support me. And I’m very happy to be supported by them. See? No one’s losing. Everyone’s happy. Isn’t that great?”
I proudly asserted my natural rights as a childhood friend.
Besides, I made a promise when we were kids. That old me was seriously GJ.
Come to think of it, I’ve always been smart. Maybe I’m a genius.
Ichinose looked at me like she’d seen something unbelievable.
“Is it really okay for you to make such shameless claims so boldly as a man, Kuzuhara-sama!?”
“Of course it is.”
I answered immediately without hesitation.
“Pride as a man? You want to keep working for decades because of that? I say no way. That kind of life is crap.”
“Wha—”
If I had to work for something like that, I’d immediately dunk that tiny pride in the trash can. Actually, I already did. I don’t want to be a corporate slave.
“I’ve decided never to work in my life. I’ve long since discarded any cheap pride that would get in the way. I’ll be supported and live playing. That’s non-negotiable.”
“That’s… what a…”
Ichinose trembled as she looked at my confident, arrogant posture.
She shook like she was scared of something. Her big eyes flickered, and her face flushed.
(Ah, did I make her angry after all?)
Thinking I’d said something bad, I tried to back off, but—
“What a scumbag… how despicable… no pride… such a hopeless, garbage-like scumbag… I never thought you’d be such a useless person…”
Ichinose staggered toward me, as if feverish.
“That is, that is just too much…”
“Hey, are you okay…?”
“It’s exactly my ideal…”
“Huh?”
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aNRxanq.jpeg

It all happened in the blink of an eye. Before I knew it, I was being hugged tightly, her hands wrapped around my back. Then she said,  
“Finally, finally I have found… my master whom I must serve…”  
Her face flushed red as she spoke those words.

A few seconds. Or maybe even longer.  
Who could blame me for tilting my head in confusion?  
Being hugged by a maid bunny was one thing, but I couldn’t make any sense of what she was saying.

“...Excuse me?”  
Huh? What is this? What does it mean?
As if answering my question, Ichinose opened her mouth slightly.

“I have been searching all along. For someone like you—a hopeless scumbag with a rotten core. Someone who’s utterly useless, who’s thrown away their pride and only thinks about their own convenience, someone who’s basically beyond help, a born loser…”

“Whoa… you really going that far?”  
I’m just living honestly as myself…
Despite my bewilderment, Ichinose’s declaration didn’t stop.

“A person like that was exactly my ideal master. Because you’re a scumbag, it makes serving you as a maid all the more rewarding. But I thought such a worthless person was just a dream, someone who couldn’t possibly exist. And now, I have finally found you. Right now, I, Himeno, am very happy…”

“Uh, uh huh, I see. I don’t really get it, but that’s impressive, I guess.”  
She seemed moved, but I couldn’t tell if she was praising me or mocking me—it was too ambiguous for words.
“Have confidence. Know that you are the lowest kind of scumbag. Kazuma Kuzuhara, you are the fated master of this Ichinose Himeno.”
“Uh… so, basically… I’ve been officially recognized as your master by Ichinose?”
“Yes.”
“No way. So, you’re gonna spoil me?”
“Of course.”
“Like, cleaning and all the other stuff, can I count on you for that too?”
“Please, command me anything. You are already my master.”
Ichinose nodded with few words. As always, her expression was blank, but she didn’t seem to be lying.
Feeling a surge of joy welling up inside me, I couldn’t help but throw up a fist in triumph.
“Yes! Woohoo!”
Somehow, I’d gotten myself a beautiful maid who would spoil me! I really am a lucky guy! I’m gonna ride this wave and sing the praises of life!

“Kazu-kun?”  
“Kazuma?”  
“Oh, sorry.”
My moment of happiness was short-lived. When I looked up, my two childhood friends were staring at us with intense eyes.
Sorry, I totally forgot about you two. Yeah, my bad.
